cases.note: Every value of the v1:agents:agent role enum: callable by any agent, and by no person over MCP, who is not an agent kind.

cases.message: @requiresAgentRole on a tool takes one or more strings
"system-planner" is not an agent role: v1:agents:agent.role is one of assistant, specialist
cases.note: The values are the agent concept's own role enum. A roleSlug is not a role: no agent's role is ever "system-planner", so the value would admit no agent (memql#5438).

cases.message: or @requiresRank("<role>") if the gate is on the person the call is for rather than on the agent
cases.note: A person's role on the agent axis is refused naming the gate it belongs to.
